title: Stop Paying for Claude Unlock UNLIMITED Tokens for FREE 🤯 #shorts  #ai #technology #aitutorial
description:
Are you tired of seeing the dreaded "Token limit reached" error while working in Claude Code? In this video, I reveal a mind-blowing open-source tool on GitHub called OmniRoute. It acts as a free AI gateway, plugging your Claude Code into over 200 different AI providers—with 90 of them being completely free.

By stacking these free tiers together, you can unlock an insane 1.6 billion free tokens every single month!

Massive Access: One single endpoint gives you access to the biggest models in the world without paying premium subscription fees.
